Name: Flower Baby (Lifeweaver Overwatch 2)
Author: Wolfina2
Description:
An adorable new livestock available for coop. Flower baby! Adds a flower baby to your game. Requires Content Patcher

Adds Lifeweaver from Overwatch 2 into the game as a coop animal. Drops Fairy Roses and Hard Wood.

Made it as a joke for my friends, enjoy.

Downloads.Description: The main flower baby files add to your mods folder or use nexus vortex
